neighbours.label: Word-piece 'ie' ending a split name like Pix|ie, Trix|ie, Dix|ie (also Pis|idia)
fire: The hikers followed the Pixie Trail for half a mile before turning down to the grove.
Burlesque performer Trixie Little won the duet award that year in Las Vegas.
Her playlist included a song called Pixie Death Tickle with soft, buoyant rhythms.
They toured with the Dixie Chicks and several other country acts across the south.
A video called Pixie Fail went viral after the toddler tripped over her costume wings.
The little Pixie costume was a hit at the school party, and everyone took photos.
We played Dixie Land jazz at the festival while the crowd danced near the stage.
Her nickname Trixie stuck from childhood, and even her teachers used it in class.
